summary_paragraph: A 30-year-old woman with a history of endometriosis, bipolar disorder, and recent pneumonia was readmitted with right-sided pleuritic chest and back pain, diarrhea, and headache. She had recently completed a course of levofloxacin, which she discontinued due to gastrointestinal side effects. Imaging revealed no pulmonary embolism or active infection; the pain was attributed to musculoskeletal or post-viral causes. Diarrhea resolved spontaneously and was likely antibiotic-associated. Hyperglycemia was noted, with A1C pending. Anxiety related to recent mania and current symptoms improved with continued psychiatric medications. She was discharged home with tramadol for pain, instructions to follow up on mental health and glucose issues, and advised to monitor for worsening symptoms.
